surfaces.name: Parallel Code desktop app (Electron, SolidJS, TypeScript; macOS universal and Linux builds)
Phone access: phone web UI served by the desktop app and a native Android companion app
Local token-protected MCP server that lets coordinator agents create and manage tasks

claims.answer: Desktop app for macOS (universal dmg, signed and notarized) and Linux (AppImage, amd64 deb); no Windows installer (source build through Git Bash only). Phone UI in any mobile browser through Connect Phone, and an Android companion app documented as an APK from GitHub releases (no APK found in releases). No iOS app, no editor extension, no hosted web client.
